title: Golf Committee Meeting — CANCELLED
summary: Cancelled. Next meeting: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at 2:00 PM.
public_detail: Golf Advisory Committee Updates - August 2026 There is no Golf Advisory Committee meeting on Tuesday, August 11, 2026. The next scheduled meeting will be held on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, 2PM EST….please mark your calendars. Golf Course Maintenance Report - Submitted by Randy Mitchell & Joe Clay, Superintendent Work on sandtraps - New trap by the 1st green is completed; sand was added by the 3rd & 5th green; the new sod for the greens will be installed next week; this sod will be used to replace the infected spots on all greens; no future need to buy sod from the sod farm, will be growing our own; there will be sand located in the parking lot that is going to be placed on the golf course. All shrubs & weeds were removed from the west side of the Pro Shop; new ground cover and some low growing plants will be added; On the south side of the Pro Shop, weeds and plants will be removed and replaced with lower maintenance plants; new sprinklers have been installed by the 1st green. The white fence around the maintenance shed was damaged by a car and will be repaired at the cost of the driver's insurance. Respectfully submitted, Caroline Zimmerman, Chair Golf Advisory Committee
